jobs.prompt: Bump the version from 1.167.11 to 1.167.12. In package.json and package-lock.json (both places in the lock: the top version and packages[""].version) change 1.167.11 to 1.167.12. In README.md change every 1.167.11 pin (kickoff text, tag name) to 1.167.12.
